intro.text: A fortified Shin monastery near the southern coast, built to help repel coastal raiders.

description.text: Large gates open into a gemstone-lit hall with a ceremonial stone before an altar. A single great slab forms its roof.

items.text: Szeth began his training pilgrimage here under Sivi, the Willshaper Honorbearer.
Sivi resisted the influence corrupting Shinovar. The people of the district gathered in Koring, while the monastery was boarded shut.
Szeth and Kaladin entered through the roof and found Sivi dead beside a message of resistance. Szeth opened the gates and recovered the Willshaper Honorblade.
